en.headline: Observatory issues amber rainstorm warning before dawn
en.dek: An amber rainstorm warning has been in force since 4am Saturday, with the Observatory warning of possible severe flooding in Sai Kung and on Lantau.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued an amber rainstorm warning at 4am on Saturday. A thunderstorm warning issued at 3:55pm on Friday remains in force until 7:30am.

In a localised heavy-rain announcement, the Observatory said rain was particularly heavy in Sai Kung and on Lantau Island in the Islands District, and that serious flooding was possible. It said those areas had recorded, or were expected to record, rainfall of more than 70 millimetres an hour, and asked people who might be affected to take precautions.

Shortly after 4am the Observatory said a band of intense thunderstorms linked to an upper-air disturbance was affecting Hong Kong, and that whether a red rainstorm warning was needed would depend on how that band developed. It asked the public to stay highly alert and to follow the latest weather information.

At 6am the Observatory recorded 25 degrees and relative humidity of 93 per cent. Between 4:45am and 5:45am it logged lightning over Lantau, the eastern New Territories, Hong Kong Island and Kowloon. The forecast for Saturday is cloudy with showers at times, and heavy rain and thunderstorms in some areas in the morning, with temperatures of 27 to 31 degrees and a moderate easterly wind.

zh.headline: 天文台凌晨四時發出黃色暴雨警告
zh.dek: 黃色暴雨警告自周六凌晨四時生效，天文台指西貢及大嶼山雨勢特別大，可能出現嚴重水浸。
body: 香港天文台周六凌晨四時發出黃色暴雨警告信號。周五下午三時五十五分發出的雷暴警告仍然生效，有效時間至周六上午七時三十分。
天文台發出局部地區大雨提示，指西貢區及離島區的大嶼山雨勢特別大，可能出現嚴重水浸。上述地區已錄得或預料會有每小時超過70毫米的大雨，可能受影響的市民應採取預防措施，減低水浸引致的損失。
凌晨四時後，天文台表示與高空擾動相關的強雷雨區正影響本港，是否需要發出紅色暴雨警告信號，要視乎該雷雨區的發展，並呼籲市民保持高度警惕，留意最新天氣消息。
上午六時，天文台錄得氣溫25度，相對濕度93%。上午四時四十五分至五時四十五分，大嶼山、新界東、港島及九龍有閃電記錄。周六預測大致多雲，間中有驟雨，早上部分地區雨勢頗大及有幾陣雷暴，氣溫介乎27至31度，吹和緩偏東風。
